Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0; licences included).
English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese fast trained data downloaded from https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast/ on 2026-10-21, from the Tesseract project (Apache-2.0).
OCR runs in the browser; images are not sent to a third-party recognition service.
